preconditions.description: The input must be a list of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each element in the input list must be a string.
Each string in the input list must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The output list must have the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for i, char in enumerate(word) if char.lower() == chr(97 + i)) for word, count in zip(words, return_value))
postconditions.description: Each count in the output list must represent the number of letters in the corresponding word that occupy their positions in the alphabet.
